title: Moxley vs. Omega: from Lights Out to world-title warfare
summary: The rivalry moves from an unsanctioned fight into a championship feud shaped by Don Callis and the Elite.

chapters.title: Lights Out in Baltimore
chapters.result: Moxley beats Omega in an unsanctioned Lights Out match.
chapters.context: Their first major singles confrontation establishes the rivalry’s violent tone.

chapters.title: Callis helps Omega take the title
chapters.result: Omega defeats Moxley after using a microphone supplied through Callis’s interference.
chapters.context: Omega and Callis leave together and tease an appearance on Impact.

chapters.title: Exploding barbed wire and an old friend
chapters.result: Omega retains; Eddie Kingston rushes in to protect Moxley afterward.
chapters.context: The aftermath begins repairing the bond between Moxley and Kingston.
